name: inverting-amp-15
prompt: Build an inverting op-amp amplifier with a voltage gain of 15, powered from ±9 V split supplies (both rails are available). The input comes from a signal source.
notes: Complement to opamp-preamp (which was non-inverting, single supply). Gain is Rf/Rin = 15, which is not a clean single E24 pair (e.g. 15k/1k works exactly; austerity in value choice is measurable). The split supply removes the bias-network excuse: V+ and V- both have rails.
